code.r:
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(dplyr)

con = dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(), dbname = "bluebikes")

con %>%
  tbl("tally_rush_edges") %>%
  filter(start_code == "A32010") %>%
  summarize(trips = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  collect()
code.sql:
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT sum(count) AS trips
FROM tally_rush_edges
WHERE start_code = 'A32010';

code.r:
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(dplyr)

con = dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(), dbname = "bluebikes")

con %>%
  tbl("trips_by_station_month") %>%
  summarize(trips = sum(trips, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  collect()
code.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW trips_by_station_month AS
  SELECT start_code, substr(day, 1, 7) AS month, sum(count) AS trips
  FROM tally_rush_edges
  GROUP BY start_code, month;

EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT sum(trips) AS trips
FROM trips_by_station_month;
